card.name: Just before atrial and AV block terms
card.fires_on: Words just before atrial or heart-conduction terms, such as the W of Wenckebach, Mobitz type I or II, and linking words before atrial septal defects or atrial fibrillation. Seen in cardiac side-effect and warning text.

modes.label: Heart block naming
modes.description: The start of Wenckebach or the type number after Mobitz, within AV block wording.

modes.label: Linking word before atrial
modes.description: A small word or bracket right before the word atrial or supraventricular in cardiac text.
modes.example: ventricular septal defects (VSDs)<< and>> atrial septal defects (ASDs

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like atr, atri and rhe, as in atrial and rhythm, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up just before the next word is likely to be atrial or a heart block name.
